## Terms & Conditions
- Trade JASMYUSDT Perpetual Futures during the campaign. Cumulative trading volume includes both opening and closing orders, as well as Long and Short positions.
- Unlock trading volume milestones to earn Futures Coupon rewards. Higher cumulative trading volume unlocks higher reward tiers.
- Rewards from all unlocked tiers are cumulative. For example, if a user reaches 10,000 USDT in cumulative JASMYUSDT Futures trading volume, they will unlock the corresponding milestone and receive the total rewards from all unlocked tiers.
- Complete campaign tasks to earn additional rewards, including Cumulative Deposit Tasks, First JASMYUSDT Futures Trade, and Invite Friends.
- Each eligible user can receive up to 2,130 USDT in total rewards during the campaign. Rewards will be distributed automatically based on completed tasks and unlocked trading milestones.
- Only filled orders count toward trading volume. Cancelled orders will not be counted.
- Futures Coupons may be used as trading margin. Profits generated using Futures Coupons are withdrawable, while the coupons themselves are non-withdrawable.
- Fraudulent activities, including self-trading, wash trading, or any form of market manipulation, are strictly prohibited and will result in disqualification.
- Biconomy reserves the right to the final interpretation of this campaign.
